document.name: 2 Ton Split Air Conditioner 24000 BTU
document.description: 2-ton piston split air conditioner with 24000 BTU capacity. Features self-cleaning, Golden Fin, 4D air flow, a 5-year compressor warranty, piston compressor, strong air flow, auto restart, and auto diagnosis. Uses R410A refrigerant (1.55 kg). Current 8.78 A; maximum current 18.5 A; power input 1980 W; maximum power input 3450 W; indoor air volume 1300 m³/h; annual energy consumption 4560 kWh/year; power factor 0.98; indoor noise 50 dB(A), outdoor noise 61 dB(A). Indoor net/gross weight 14/17 kg; outdoor net/gross weight 61/65.5 kg. Indoor dimensions 1253 × 330 × 409 mm; outdoor dimensions 987 × 789 × 445 mm. Power supply: 220–240 V / 50 Hz.
